meta.title: Advisory — Johan Nilsson
meta.description: Market entry and franchise partnerships, operations and growth, investment through Stockholm Leisure Partners, and board roles in business and sport.

sections.label: Advisory
sections.quote: A brand is global. <t>A market is local.</t>
sections.sub: Partnership and advisory for brands entering new markets, for operators scaling, and for the boards that guide them.

sections.label: Engagements
sections.title: Where the work <t>usually begins.</t>
items: A global brand that wants to enter the Nordics, or another European market, with a partner who has done it before.
A first studio that works, and a second, third and fourth that need to work the same way.
Two operators of one brand in neighbouring countries, and the case for becoming one company.
A founder with a fitness or wellness concept, looking for capital that understands the floor as well as the spreadsheet.
A board that needs someone at the table who has carried a P&L.
A federation or club that wants its elite game run with the discipline of a commercial brand.

sections.label: Areas of practice
sections.title: Who the practice <t>serves.</t>
sections.lede: Each grounded in a chapter of twenty-five years.

cards.label: Market Entry & Partnerships · Global brands & franchise partners
cards.title: Which partner opens this market?
cards.desc: The Barry’s chapter, applied to a new country: the market, the partner, the licence, the site and the launch, done in a way the brand’s headquarters can trust.
items: Operating as partner in the new company

cards.label: Operations & Growth · Studio & club operators
cards.title: How does one site become many?
cards.desc: Ten years as CEO of a multi-country operator: standards, people and numbers that let a concept scale, and the case for merging operators into one company.

cards.label: Investment · Founders of health & fitness concepts
cards.title: Whose capital has run the floor?
cards.desc: Through Stockholm Leisure Partners, an investor focused on the health and fitness industry: capital with operating experience, from the first studio to the Nordic and European market.
items: Investments have included Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize

cards.label: Boards & Sport · Boards, federations & clubs
cards.title: Who sits at the table?
cards.desc: Board roles in business and in sport: strategy, commercial development and organisation, with the view of someone who has carried a P&L.
items: Commercial development of the elite game

steps.d: Demand, competition, sites and price points, read as an operator rather than as a consultant: what will the floor look like on a Tuesday morning?
A brand entering a country lives or dies by its local partner. The structure, the licence and the people are agreed before the site.
Site, team, product and launch, run to the brand’s standard. A first studio that opens strong carries the ones that follow.
Profitable growth, studio by studio: the standards and reporting that let a concept scale and, when the time comes, merge or sell.

terms.v: Partnerships, retained advisory, board roles and investment
Stockholm, with work in Zürich, Madrid and Helsinki
Agreed in writing before work begins
